Lemma
[Weighted oblique estimate on a half-space domain] 1. ch6:6.27\group gt-ch06 Under the hypotheses of Theorem 6.26 on a bounded half-space domain, \[ |u|^*_{2,\alpha ;\Omega \cup T} \le C\bigl(|u|_{0;\Omega }+|\varphi |_{1,\alpha ;T}+|f|_{0,\alpha ;\Omega }\bigr). \]
